Mission Local reported that the State Bar sent DA Brooke Jenkins to a diversionary program after a two-and-a-half-year process. The story says the Bar treated the ethics complaints as “best resolved” by requiring her participation, and reports that the remaining complaints were set aside except for the one involving her access to and sharing of a confidential rap sheet.

The story carries no correction.
